form.label: PSIMS / SureView Enterprise Signal Flow Health - v4
form.description: Production-grade observability dashboard for verified CloudLink Windows Application events. Uses same-time-of-day 5-day baselines, data-freshness checks, host-level flow comparison, anomaly candidates, diagnostic errors, and validated-no-data handling. DB queue telemetry is intentionally deferred until schema confirmation.

search.query: index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" | search host IN ("GPWMA00A0001","GPWMA00A0002","GRWMA00A0001","GRWMA00A0002") | stats count by host | sort host | fields host

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ earliest=-5d@d latest=now | eval Day=relative_time(_time,"@d"), Today=relative_time(now(),"@d"), SecIntoDay=_time-Day, Cutoff=now()-Today | where Day=Today OR SecIntoDay<=Cutoff | stats count as Total count(eval(EventCode=33)) as E33 count(eval(EventCode=34)) as E34 count(eval(EventCode=55)) as E55 latest(_time) as LastSeen dc(host) as ActiveHosts by Day | eventstats avg(eval(if(Day<Today,Total,null()))) as BaseTotal avg(eval(if(Day<Today,E55,null()))) as Base55 | where Day=Today | eval VolumeVar=if(BaseTotal>0,((Total-BaseTotal)/BaseTotal)*100,null()), Error55Var=if(Base55>0,((E55-Base55)/Base55)*100,null()), AgeMin=if(isnull(LastSeen),999999,(now()-LastSeen)/60) | eval Health=case(isnull(LastSeen),"UNKNOWN - NO DATA",AgeMin>=$fresh_crit$,"CRITICAL - CLOUDLINK SILENT",VolumeVar>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL - VOLUME ANOMALY",Error55Var>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL - EVENT55 ANOMALY",AgeMin>=$fresh_warn$,"WARNING - ACTIVITY STALE",VolumeVar>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING - VOLUME ABOVE BASELINE",Error55Var>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING - EVENT55 ABOVE BASELINE",true(),"NORMAL") | fields Health

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ earliest=-5d@d latest=now | eval Day=relative_time(_time,"@d"), Today=relative_time(now(),"@d"), SecIntoDay=_time-Day, Cutoff=now()-Today | where Day=Today OR SecIntoDay<=Cutoff | stats count as Events by Day | eventstats avg(eval(if(Day<Today,Events,null()))) as FiveDayAvg | where Day=Today | eval Percent=if(FiveDayAvg>0,round(((Events-FiveDayAvg)/FiveDayAvg)*100,1),null()) | eval Result=if(isnull(Percent),"UNKNOWN",tostring(Percent)."%") | fields Result

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ | stats latest(_time) as LastSeen | eval Minutes=if(isnull(LastSeen),null(),round((now()-LastSeen)/60,1)) | fields Minutes

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" | search host IN ("GPWMA00A0001","GPWMA00A0002","GRWMA00A0001","GRWMA00A0002") | stats dc(host) as ActiveHosts | eval Result=ActiveHosts." / 4" | fields Result

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ EventCode=33 earliest=-5d@d latest=now | eval Day=relative_time(_time,"@d"), Today=relative_time(now(),"@d"), SecIntoDay=_time-Day, Cutoff=now()-Today | where Day=Today OR SecIntoDay<=Cutoff | stats count as Events by Day | eventstats avg(eval(if(Day<Today,Events,null()))) as Base | where Day=Today | eval Pct=if(Base>0,round(((Events-Base)/Base)*100,1),null()), Status=case(isnull(Pct),"UNKNOWN",Pct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL",Pct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Result=Status." | ".Pct."% | Now=".Events." | Avg=".round(Base,0) | fields Result

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ EventCode=34 earliest=-5d@d latest=now | eval Day=relative_time(_time,"@d"), Today=relative_time(now(),"@d"), SecIntoDay=_time-Day, Cutoff=now()-Today | where Day=Today OR SecIntoDay<=Cutoff | stats count as Events by Day | eventstats avg(eval(if(Day<Today,Events,null()))) as Base | where Day=Today | eval Pct=if(Base>0,round(((Events-Base)/Base)*100,1),null()), Status=case(isnull(Pct),"UNKNOWN",Pct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL",Pct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Result=Status." | ".Pct."% | Now=".Events." | Avg=".round(Base,0) | fields Result

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ EventCode=55 earliest=-5d@d latest=now | eval Day=relative_time(_time,"@d"), Today=relative_time(now(),"@d"), SecIntoDay=_time-Day, Cutoff=now()-Today | where Day=Today OR SecIntoDay<=Cutoff | stats count as Events by Day | eventstats avg(eval(if(Day<Today,Events,null()))) as Base | where Day=Today | eval Pct=if(Base>0,round(((Events-Base)/Base)*100,1),null()), Status=case(isnull(Pct),"UNKNOWN",Pct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL",Pct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Result=Status." | ".Pct."% | Now=".Events." | Avg=".round(Base,0) | fields Result

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ (EventCode=33 OR EventCode=34) | stats count(eval(EventCode=33)) as Received33 count(eval(EventCode=34)) as Sent34 | eval Gap=Received33-Sent34, GapPct=if(Received33>0,round((Gap/Received33)*100,2),null()) | eval Result="Gap=".Gap." | ".GapPct."%" | fields Result

table.title: Today vs Previous 5 Days at the Same Time of Day

search.query: index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ earliest=-5d@d latest=now | eval Day=relative_time(_time,"@d"), Today=relative_time(now(),"@d"), SecIntoDay=_time-Day, Cutoff=now()-Today | where Day=Today OR SecIntoDay<=Cutoff | stats count as Total count(eval(EventCode=33)) as Event33 count(eval(EventCode=34)) as Event34 count(eval(EventCode=55)) as Event55 by Day | eval IsToday=if(Day=Today,1,0), Date=strftime(Day,"%Y-%m-%d") | eventstats avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Total,null()))) as AvgTotal avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Event33,null()))) as Avg33 avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Event34,null()))) as Avg34 avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Event55,null()))) as Avg55 | eval TotalVarPct=round(((Total-AvgTotal)/AvgTotal)*100,1), E33VarPct=round(((Event33-Avg33)/Avg33)*100,1), E34VarPct=round(((Event34-Avg34)/Avg34)*100,1), E55VarPct=round(((Event55-Avg55)/Avg55)*100,1) | eval Status=if(IsToday=1,case(TotalVarPct>=$crit_pct$ OR E55VarPct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL",TotalVarPct>=$warn_pct$ OR E55VarPct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL"),"BASELINE DAY") | table Date IsToday Total AvgTotal TotalVarPct Event33 Avg33 E33VarPct Event34 Avg34 E34VarPct Event55 Avg55 E55VarPct Status | sort - Date

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ (EventCode=33 OR EventCode=34) | eval Flow=case(EventCode=33,"Event 33",EventCode=34,"Event 34") | timechart span=5m count by Flow
index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ EventCode=55 | timechart span=5m count as Event55

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" | search host IN ("GPWMA00A0001","GPWMA00A0002","GRWMA00A0001","GRWMA00A0002") | search host=$host_tok$ | stats count as Total count(eval(EventCode=33)) as Event33 count(eval(EventCode=34)) as Event34 count(eval(EventCode=55)) as Event55 latest(_time) as LastSeen by host | eval AgeMin=round((now()-LastSeen)/60,1), Gap=Event33-Event34, GapPct=if(Event33>0,round((Gap/Event33)*100,2),null()) | eval Health=case(isnull(LastSeen),"UNKNOWN",AgeMin>=$fresh_crit$,"CRITICAL - NO ACTIVITY",AgeMin>=$fresh_warn$,"WARNING - STALE",true(),"ACTIVE") | eval LastSeen=strftime(LastSeen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table host Health AgeMin Total Event33 Event34 Gap GapPct Event55 LastSeen | sort host

table.title: Baseline Alert Candidates - Returns Rows Only When Threshold Is Breached

search.query: index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" earliest=-5d@d latest=now | search host IN ("GPWMA00A0001","GPWMA00A0002","GRWMA00A0001","GRWMA00A0002") | eval Day=relative_time(_time,"@d"), Today=relative_time(now(),"@d"), SecIntoDay=_time-Day, Cutoff=now()-Today | where Day=Today OR SecIntoDay<=Cutoff | stats count as Total count(eval(EventCode=33)) as E33 count(eval(EventCode=34)) as E34 count(eval(EventCode=55)) as E55 latest(_time) as LastSeen by host Day | eventstats avg(eval(if(Day<Today,Total,null()))) as AvgTotal avg(eval(if(Day<Today,E55,null()))) as Avg55 by host | where Day=Today | eval TotalVarPct=if(AvgTotal>0,round(((Total-AvgTotal)/AvgTotal)*100,1),null()), E55VarPct=if(Avg55>0,round(((E55-Avg55)/Avg55)*100,1),null()), AgeMin=round((now()-LastSeen)/60,1) | eval Trigger=case(AgeMin>=$fresh_crit$,"CRITICAL: NO CLOUDLINK ACTIVITY",TotalVarPct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL: TOTAL VOLUME ABOVE BASELINE",E55VarPct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL: EVENT55 ABOVE BASELINE",AgeMin>=$fresh_warn$,"WARNING: CLOUDLINK ACTIVITY STALE",TotalVarPct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING: TOTAL VOLUME ABOVE BASELINE",E55VarPct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING: EVENT55 ABOVE BASELINE",true(),null()) | where isnotnull(Trigger) | eval LastSeen=strftime(LastSeen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table host Trigger Total AvgTotal TotalVarPct E55 Avg55 E55VarPct E33 E34 AgeMin LastSeen | sort Trigger host

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ | search (EventCode=55 OR Message="*invalid_signal*" OR Message="*Failed to decode signal*" OR Message="*Timeout*" OR Message="*exception*" OR Message="*failed*" OR Message="*error*") | eval EventTime=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table EventTime host EventCode Type Message | sort - EventTime

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" host=$host_tok$ | rex field=Message max_match=0 "(?i)(?<SignalCode>s007|aBU|rBU|aPN|rPN|s016|s017|s072|s073|s087|s121|aSV|rSV|tSV|tA1|rA1|dA1)" | mvexpand SignalCode | stats count by SignalCode | sort - count

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" host=$host_tok$ | search Message="*s016*" OR Message="*s072*" OR Message="*s087*" OR Message="*aBU*" OR Message="*aPN*" OR Message="*invalid_signal*" OR Message="*Timeout*" | eval EventTime=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table EventTime host SourceName EventCode Type Message | sort - EventTime

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ | eval EventTime=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval Meaning=case(EventCode=33,"Observed Event 33",EventCode=34,"Observed Event 34",EventCode=41,"Tunnel Candidate 41",EventCode=48,"Tunnel Candidate 48",EventCode=49,"Tunnel Candidate 49",EventCode=55,"Review Event 55",true(),"Other") | table EventTime host EventCode Meaning Type Message | sort - EventTime

html.p: Baseline design: Today's cumulative event volume is compared with the previous five days only up to the same time of day. This avoids comparing a partial production day with five complete days.
No-data safety: Missing or stale CloudLink data is never treated as healthy. The dashboard reports UNKNOWN, WARNING, or CRITICAL based on the freshness thresholds above.

Event semantics: Event 33, 34, and 55 are monitored as observed CloudLink event IDs. Their exact business meaning should remain provisional until validated against vendor documentation or confirmed raw-message patterns.
Phase 2 - DB queue: Queue depth, oldest pending signal, drain rate, enqueue rate, last processed signal, and queue-stall detection will be added when the production queue table/schema is confirmed.
